jobs.title: 1 · Apoio azul orgânico
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE simple blue irregular BACKING CONTAINER sprite behind a separate red piggy-bank character in a casual mobile game HUD.
This is a solid three-dimensional backing/support for the event icon, not a picture frame or heraldic emblem. Its filled blue front face will be mostly covered by the pig, and its substantial dark-blue bottom wall will show underneath, giving the pig a little supportive shelf. Design a softly rounded ASYMMETRICAL organic silhouette, a slightly crooked chunky blue plastic/enamel cushion or tile. A simple unbordered blue contour with a couple of broad soft bumps, gently tilted/skewed, visibly not a perfect circle, oval, square, shield or symmetric badge. The upper edge is a low irregular hump rather than a high arch. The bottom edge is round and broad, not pointed. The object is a shallow convex slab, with a royal-blue front, brighter turquoise highlight on the upper left, cobalt thick sidewall on the lower right and one soft navy contact shadow. Restrained glossy cartoon finish with broad soft reflections, simple painted lighting, no photorealism. Use only BLUE shades. No gold, purple, metal, rim rings, inset rings, frame molding, holes, hollow center, stars, snow, bows, jewels, letters, seals, perforations, filigree, ribbons, numbers, text, pig or animals. Centered single complete asset with true transparent background outside, square canvas and modest padding. Readable at 80 pixels. A separate large pig overlaps this shape; do not render that pig.
Silhouette variation: asymmetrical rounded triangular pebble with NO pointed corners: left edge bulges out halfway up, right edge rises a bit higher, bottom is a soft wide curve leaning down-left. Thicker lower blue lip, soft diagonal top highlight. Quiet and minimal.

jobs.title: A · Tempo em roxo
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one SEPARATE blank event COUNTDOWN LABEL BACKGROUND sprite, placed underneath an event icon in a casual mobile game HUD. This is a wide horizontal time plaque for live text like "2d 04h", NOT a round notification dot. It must have a broad empty text area, a rounded chunky outline, a subtle soft beveled sidewall, simple broad glossy cartoon highlights and clean readable shape at 80px width. Absolutely NO painted text, digits, symbols, clocks, exclamation marks or icons. Straight-on view, complete standalone wide short plaque centered on transparent canvas, about 3.1 times as wide as high. Entire outer background truly transparent. No ornate metal frame, decorative curls, ropes, screws, jewels or props. Deep plum-purple filled face with lighter violet upper edge and darker purple soft sidewall, a very thin pale-cream outline, rounded capsule silhouette. Simple cohesive purple label for white countdown text. No gold trim.
